scope: Requirements-level data contracts and exception categories for Q116-Q119 and Q121. Not a risk calculator, broker adapter, money manager, or permission to trade.

preorder_includes: unfilled pending orders under possible execution
adopted_policy.preorder_normalization: JPY-denominated conservative stop-based maximum estimated loss; reject new orders when unavailable or exceeds a limit
adopted_policy.daily_loss_main_measure: NY17:00 start-to-current equity change adjusted for net external cash transfers, independently reconciled with realized/unrealized PnL and financing/cost events
adopted_policy.daily_limit_reset: next trading-day start at 17:00 America/New_York respecting DST; opening equity fixed within that trading day
adopted_policy.drawdown_basis: unitized equity adjusted for external deposits/withdrawals; unit value high-water tracking
adopted_policy.dd4_dd5_order_stop_clearing: explicit human approval required; numeric improvement alone is insufficient
adopted_policy.gaps_slippage: planned-stop-loss risk estimates do not guarantee realized upper bounds

snapshot_domains.name: ACCOUNT_EQUITY_CURRENT
required_evidence: authoritative account and account-currency identity
equity valuation with broker observation time and local reception time
identity linkage to positions, orders, prices and conversion snapshot
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: acceptable broker timestamp/quote staleness, margin context and precise synchronized read/lock rule

snapshot_domains.name: OPEN_POSITIONS
required_evidence: complete per-position identifiers, side and volume
entry/SL and valuation inputs
pending fills, manual/intervening changes and data origin
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: position reconciliation, partial-close semantics and shared account concurrency

snapshot_domains.name: UNFILLED_AND_DISPATCHING_ORDERS
required_evidence: all broker-side unfilled/pending orders plus durable dispatch/in-flight local intents
execution possibility and reservation/overlap history
unique operation/attempt IDs and reconciliation status
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: simultaneous order reservations, fill/partial fill double counting, uncertain order results and hedged risk treatment

snapshot_domains.name: FX_VALUATION_AND_CONVERSION
required_evidence: symbol and quote currency
broker pip/tick value and conversion to account/JPY where applicable
bid/ask side, observation/receipt times and spread/cost assumptions
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: exact pair/cross-currency pricing algorithm, broker symbol contract specs, rounding and fees

snapshot_domains.name: NY17_OPENING_EQUITY
required_evidence: trading-day ID from America/New_York calendar with DST
single committed day-opening equity amount, account identity and timestamp
provenance, durability and recovery record
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: how to create missing snapshots, downtime at boundary, market holidays, clock jumps and time provider failure

snapshot_domains.name: EXTERNAL_CASHFLOW_LEDGER
required_evidence: external deposit/withdrawal classification and signed amount
effective time, settlement versus broker display time, reversals/corrections
account currency and matching ledger/position events
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: which transfers are external versus internal, midnight/NY boundary ordering, delayed booking and double-entry verification

snapshot_domains.name: INDEPENDENT_PNL_COST_RECONCILIATION
required_evidence: realized and unrealized PnL components
commissions, swap, financing and fees without counting twice
coverage and temporal alignment with equity and cashflow ledger
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: tolerance policy, incomplete swap posting, profits offset losses and cause-specific stop rules

snapshot_domains.name: DD_UNITIZATION_HISTORY
required_evidence: committed virtual units and unit value across flows
high-water snapshot and observation history
equity-at-flow valuation and replay-safe unit adjustments
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: initial unit price/units, issuance/redemption formula, zero/negative equity, multiple flows, precision and reset/restore

snapshot_domains.name: DATA_INTEGRITY_CLOCK_AND_STOP_STATE
required_evidence: data-source identity, reception and origin times and validity flags
explicit failed/missing/late/ambiguous status
durable stop-reason latches, operator approvals and order state after restart
snapshot_domains.not_finalized: per-domain freshness thresholds except separately adopted DD clearance data <=15 seconds, cross-feed consistency windows and active safety modes

boundaries.fact: Current equity for 0.5/1.0% pre-order limits is NOT the daily fixed opening equity used for the 1.5% limit.
Net equity change corrected for external flows is the Q117 daily LOSS measure; the Q118 day-opening EQUITY is the limit denominator and remains fixed during day.
Q119 virtual-unit DD distinguishes deposits/withdrawals from returns and is neither daily cashflow-corrected nominal profit nor the fixed day-loss amount.
The DD monitoring-release observation freshness cap of 15 seconds from Q128 must not be assumed as a universal market-data tolerance for trade risk, FX conversion or day-opening equity.
An API/order response, SQLite DISPATCHING or unchanged position report does not prove no pending execution; Q120 and Q199 uncertainty blocks a new trade.
A daily stop released after the next NY17 boundary does not clear DD4/5, performance LEVEL3 or communication isolation stop latches.
SL estimates exclude unbounded slippage/gaps; upper percentage figures are entry-time risk gates, not a guarantee of realized absolute maximum.

review_outcomes.meaning: An attempted entry order is not authorized when required risk exposure is not calculable or a limit is violated.
Required account/time/ledger/order/unitized DD evidence is missing, inconsistent, stale or not causally ordered; maintain applicable stop latches and block new entries.
Data or daily-DD recovery cannot override other still-asserted human-gated or unresolved stop reasons.
Inputs appear coherent in a hypothetical fixture, but no quantitative implementation formula, live broker adapter or order permission is approved.

synthetic_cases.description: Account current equity stale at new-order sizing time
Current-equity/positions/FX conversion snapshots refer to different account or causally incompatible epochs
An unfilled order is missing from risk aggregation
DISPATCHING outcome unknown and candidate risks a duplicate or overlapping fill
FX/JPY conversion side or broker pip size is missing for a cross-currency trade
Minimum broker lot rounding upward would breach single-trade 0.5% exposure
NY17 opening equity snapshot missing due to downtime; day limit cannot be calculated
Opening day limit is incorrectly increased after intraday profit or deposit
External deposit at day boundary has conflicting effective/posted times
Swap or fee component double-counts in independent PnL reconciliation
Daily net equity computation disagrees with independent cost/PnL ledger
Unit issuance/redemption is unknown at withdrawal, making DD high-water invalid
Trading resumes after restart but stop latches or historical unit states were not restored
DD numerically improves but DD4/5 stop lacks explicit human release approval
Complete coherent synthetic inputs and no quantification error, but formula and production authorization remain unapproved
Disputed market quotation arrives within 15 seconds but lacks separate pre-order conversion freshness validation

unresolved_before_implementation: Define broker-authoritative equity/symbol/price and position/pending-order reconciliation with account and currency identity, timestamps and validation status.
Specify same-decision snapshot and reservation/concurrency rules; no unsupported assumption of atomic read across independent broker feeds.
Define conservative SL loss, spread, fee, pip/tick valuation and JPY conversion with safe quantities and risk upper bounds, including account-currency differences.
Define NY17:00 UTC/timezone mapping, DST, weekends/holidays and missing or delayed day-opening equity snapshot handling, audited durable record.
Define external cashflow matching/corrections, independent PnL fees/swaps reconciliation, profit offset policy, clock skew and rounding.
Define unitization initial conditions, high-water unit price, flows at identical timestamps, zero/negative equity, restarts and history gaps.
Define freshness thresholds PER DATA DOMAIN, quality and replay validation. Q128 15-second limit applies to DD monitoring-release observations only.
Define remediation, alerting and stop-reason update rules for incomplete and contradictory data; no automatic approval or startup by default.
Define and owner-approve mathematical examples and broker-specific exception tests before implementation.
not_claimed: No new formulas or exception defaults have been formally selected by the user.
No local private original archive was independently inspected by GitHub.
No risk calculation, broker connection, live order path, position closure or auto restart is implemented.
Synthetic scenarios assert draft review classifications, not measured behavior or market loss guarantees.
